tools.affordability.cashOnlyAfford: Cash purchase only (no additional mortgage capacity)
tools.affordability.disclaimer: Based on 35% debt-to-income ratio. Uzbek banks typically require 20–30% down payment.
tools.affordability.incomeLimitedNote: Existing debt payments already exceed 35% of income. Banks are unlikely to approve a new loan.
tools.affordability.livingCappedNote: Your living expenses limit how much you can pay monthly — result uses the lower of bank rules and money left after bills.
tools.affordability.livingLimitedNote: Living expenses and debt payments use all or more of your income. No room left for a mortgage payment.
tools.affordability.monthlyDebtPaymentsN: Other loans and credit payments (not the new mortgage)
tools.affordability.monthlyLivingExpense: Rent, food, utilities, transport, and other regular costs
tools.affordability.targetPriceNote: Apartment or commercial unit you plan to buy
